posts.title: What's left to say?
posts.description: Every few weeks I think: I've been rather quiet this year, and it's probably going to be the year with the lowest count of posts, and I don't even have a good emotional excuse like for some years. I have put a few small things in Drafts but even then not much. I suppose I've got the occasional HN comment or tweet (I've been putting various slop outputs in a thread).

posts.title: Maybe getting back into ABCL
posts.description: I was dusting off some old scripts the other day and thought let's check how ABCL is these days... unfortunately the last stable release is still from 2023, at 1.9.3. I see there is still quite some activity in the source repo though. And there's a plan to release 1.10 at the upcoming 2026 ELS. (Seems it didn't happen.)

posts.title: Dividing up life into eras
posts.description: This is just one of my silly "cocktail party" trains of thought (I've never been to a cocktail party). In short, more blog fodder I just felt like typing up without much careful thought or revision. It's simply amusing to me to try and divide up life, and indeed society at large, into small-ish eras focused around technological change, each suspiciously around 10 years long, with myself suspicious
